data.narrative:
Lucid Bots is a Series B robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $36.4M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 9 comparable companies—1 public and 8 private—operating in the same sector and stage. Key private comparables include Generalist AI, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, Divergent, and Exotec, providing a relevant benchmarking set for Series B robotics ventures.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method uses the $36M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, implying a valuation of $69M. The peer-median approach references three same-sector, same-stage comparables: Generalist AI ($2.0B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B), and Dexterity ($1.6B). The median valuation across these three peers is $1.8B, with a range of $1.6B to $2.0B.

The two methods produce a wide dispersion, reflecting meaningful uncertainty about Lucid Bots' position within the peer set. The stage-progression method yields $69M; peer-median yields $1.8B. The triangulated analysis supports a range from $59M (low) to $2.0B (high), with a median of $910M. This broad range reflects fundamental questions about whether Lucid Bots' traction and unit economics align with top-quartile peers or earlier-stage comparables. Resolution of this gap requires deep-dive due diligence on growth metrics, capital efficiency, and competitive positioning.
